segments.title: Build your OWN YouTube home feed
segments.say: YouTube now lets you build your own home feeds. Free users get three.

segments.title: Tap + on your Home feed
segments.say: Tap the plus at the top of Home, and describe what you want to see.

segments.title: Free: 3 · Premium: 8
segments.say: Free users can keep three feeds. Premium members get eight.

segments.title: US, English only for now
segments.say: For now it's US only, in English, and not on tablets.
